propositions: Three separate code paths for selecting verifier models all break off the default provider, causing non-default model choices to silently disable downgrade
The equality test `cfg.model == DEFAULT_MODEL` fails when models are provider-qualified (e.g. `anthropic:claude-opus-4-8`), leaving verifiers on frontier models in non-default provider deployments
Code-review's verify step declares no `model:` key and `temperature: 0` setting for greedy Pass-2 determinism never takes effect because the step runs on cfg.model instead of the standard class
All three verifier paths must resolve the reserved class names (trivial/standard/frontier) through a single shared `resolve_model_string()` function to eliminate duplication and drift
A workflow step must express verifier class selection by using the class name as its `model:` value (e.g. `model: standard`), without introducing a new schema key
